description:
## [1.0.1](https://github.com/saadbinyousaf1/sby-patches/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1) (2026-11-12)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* spoof recursion and dark mode register corruption ([022751a](https://github.com/saadbinyousaf1/sby-patches/commit/022751a89f880214fcc1fb81c2b857eab042a256))

patches.name: Bypass anti-tamper (foodpanda)
patches.description: Bypasses foodpanda's DeliveryHero MAS integrity block so re-signed / sideloaded builds no longer hit the "This device or application is not supported" screen. Required.

patches.name: Force dark mode
patches.description: Repaints foodpanda's built-in light colour constants with dark equivalents so the app runs in a real dark theme. Palette classes are located by their colour constants, so the patch survives obfuscation renames. The foodpanda pink brand colour is kept.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes foodpanda's adtech banner ads (order-tracking, home, discovery, reels) and suppresses the forced PandaMart cross-sell / grocery upsell popup.

patches.name: Spoof signature (maps fix)
patches.description: Experimental. Redirects PackageManager.getPackageInfo so the app reports foodpanda's original signing certificate, which can restore Google Maps on re-signed builds. May not work because Google Play Services verifies the installed signature out of process.
